description: Make a sprint on a project's board, in the state 'future' — start_sprint starts it, set_issues_sprint (or update_issue's 'sprint') puts issues into it. Answers with the sprint as list_sprints gives it. Needs full write access to the project (member, admin or lead); a reporter, a commenter or a read-only member is refused with the reason, as is anybody while the project is paused or archived. Written in the project's journal under your name.

endDate.description: When it ends: YYYY-MM-DD, or a moment with its zone.

goal.description: What the sprint is for, in a sentence.

name.description: The sprint's name, e.g. 'App — Sprint 2'. Two sprints may share a name; the tools then take the open one, and an id is always exact.

projectKey.description: Project key whose board gets the sprint, e.g. 'PM'.

startDate.description: When it starts: YYYY-MM-DD, or a moment with its zone. Can be set now or by start_sprint.

name: create_sprint
title: Create sprint
